pitches.A: Dead Circuit reimagines EEE labs as timed escape-room challenges designed to combat the biggest crisis in engineering education: students who show up but switch off. Teams are dropped into broken systems with one job: find the fault, fix it, escape.
pitches.B: Engineering students are disengaging at alarming rates. Dead Circuit answers with escape-room-style lab scenarios where teams diagnose realistically broken systems under timed pressure using probe-measure-hypothesis-repair loops.
pitches.C: Students do not need more slides. They need stakes. Dead Circuit transforms EEE labs into timed escape rooms where teams repair broken electrical systems before the clock hits zero.

scenarios.title: Campus Subpanel Blackout
scenarios.brief: A teaching wing has lost low-voltage distribution. Restore a DC feeder board before backup power drains.
objectives: Correct resistor substitution in divider branch

teaching.vocationalScenario: You are maintenance technicians assigned to a college workshop where a low-voltage teaching bench has failed before practical assessments. Learners must apply safe fault-finding procedure, accurate measurement, and documented repair decisions.
lectureSegment: Introduce safe isolation, proving dead, and visual inspection sequence.
Recap series/parallel voltage drops and protective device function.
Model a structured fault log: symptom, test, inference, action.
activitySegment: Teams inspect board, log first observations, and assign technician roles.
Learners probe nodes, compare measured values to expected values, and shortlist faults.
Teams execute repair plan, re-test, and present maintenance justification.
pass: Follow a safe process and identify at least one correct fault.
Use basic measurements and complete a simple fault report.
merit: Independently identify both core faults using measurement evidence.
Justify component replacement choices against circuit behaviour.
Demonstrate effective team communication and role allocation.
distinction: Diagnose and repair faults efficiently with minimal unnecessary actions.
Evaluate alternative hypotheses and reject them using data.
Produce professional maintenance documentation suitable for handover.

components.name: Fuse F1
components.clue: Visual inspection: fuse element is open.

components.name: Resistor R2
components.clue: Band code does not match schematic value.

components.name: Supply V1
components.clue: Output reads nominal under no-load test.

components.name: Load L1
components.clue: Load resistance measured in expected range.

scenarios.debrief: Protection and divider accuracy were both compromised. Correcting both restored regulated distribution.

scenarios.title: Conveyor Motor Driver Lockout
scenarios.brief: A conveyor motor refuses to start during an automated packing assessment. Driver board reports gate activity but no rotation.

teaching.vocationalScenario: You are called to an industrial learning cell where a conveyor driver has failed mid-production simulation. Learners must apply maintenance troubleshooting under time pressure while maintaining safe procedure and traceability.
lectureSegment: Review motor driver architecture and flyback protection purpose.
Explain gate-drive path, continuity checks, and safe test points.
Discuss maintenance risk of unsafe temporary shortcuts.
activitySegment: Teams map likely fault domains before touching hardware.
Learners collect electrical evidence at gate, drain, and current nodes.
Teams propose and execute a repair sequence, then verify safe restart.
pass: Identify one likely control-path fault and one safe corrective action.
Use continuity and voltage tests appropriately.
merit: Identify both faults with evidence-linked reasoning.
Carry out a safe and ordered repair process with minimal tutor input.
Explain why unsafe alternatives are rejected.
distinction: Deliver a rapid, accurate diagnosis with clean re-commissioning checks.
Correlate measurements to switching behaviour and protection design.
Present a professional technical debrief with preventive recommendations.

components.name: Flyback Diode D1
components.clue: Stripe orientation is opposite to schematic direction.

components.name: Gate Trace
components.clue: Continuity test fails between driver IC and MOSFET gate.

scenarios.debrief: Protection orientation and gate continuity were both blockers. Driver output became valid only after both fixes.

scenarios.title: Audio Amplifier Distortion Emergency
scenarios.brief: A lab demo amplifier overheats and clips badly. Recover stable bias and signal swing before the public showcase.

teaching.vocationalScenario: You are advanced maintenance trainees preparing a public engineering showcase rig. The amplifier chain fails thermal and quality checks. Learners must deliver high-standard diagnosis, repair, and technical reporting.
lectureSegment: Explain transistor bias stability and thermal runaway indicators.
Review emitter degeneration and linearity in service contexts.
Discuss capacitor polarity failures and quality assurance checks.
activitySegment: Teams analyse distorted waveform symptoms and assign test strategy.
Learners capture key bias and distortion readings, then triage fault causes.
Teams apply full repair, validate performance restoration, and defend decisions.
pass: Identify at least two relevant faults using guided measurements.
Apply basic corrective actions with supervision.
Record final operating state after repair.
merit: Diagnose all key faults and implement a coherent repair plan.
Demonstrate accurate interpretation of bias and distortion evidence.
Produce structured notes linking fault causes to outcomes.
distinction: Deliver precise and efficient full restoration with robust verification.
Evaluate circuit behaviour at system level and predict reliability impact.
Present an industry-style maintenance report with future mitigation actions.

components.name: Bias Pot RBias
components.clue: Wiper is set far beyond target quiescent point.

components.name: Input Coupling Capacitor Cin
components.clue: Electrolytic polarity reversed relative to DC bias.

repairOptions.label: Reset RBias to target idle current

scenarios.debrief: Bias, emitter stabilization, and coupling direction all impacted linear operation. Closing all three faults restored headroom and thermal stability.
